method: Every expectation was written from the sources in src/ by reading them; no analysis tool was run on the sources, and no tool's detectors, source code or output were looked at. A scratch script outside the repository ran main.js, preload.js and preload-activity.js in Node against a stand-in for the electron module and printed every ipcMain registration with the line it comes from, every window's and view's webPreferences after the merges, and the channel each exposed member invokes, sends on or listens to; its output agreed with the expectations below. main.js, preload.js, preload-activity.js and the modules in lib/ are CommonJS; renderer.js and renderer-activity.js are ES modules (index.html, activity.html); renderer-import.js is a classic script (import.html) that reaches Node and Electron through window.require, because its window has nodeIntegration on and contextIsolation off. corpus/build.mjs (as read for this set) bundles main.js and every preload*.js and copies the renderers and pages, so all three inputs contain every entry file. Roles and settings are attributed to the entry files main.js, preload.js, preload-activity.js, renderer.js, renderer-activity.js and renderer-import.js. The modules in lib/ hold no IPC call, no window, no exposeInMainWorld, no request and no storage access: lib/channels.js defines the function defineChannels and the channel objects it returns, lib/window-factory.js defines makeWindow (it returns an options object; main.js passes it to new BrowserWindow) and the defaults it merges in, lib/board-model.js holds pure functions over a board. A window setting is attributed to main.js, the file that creates the window or view, also where its value comes from DEFAULT_WEB_PREFERENCES in lib/window-factory.js. There are three windows and one view: boardWindow (preload.js), activityView (a BrowserView docked in boardWindow, preload preload-activity.js), importWindow (no preload, import.html) and printWindow (a local variable of savePdf, no preload, a data: page printed to PDF). webPreferences lists the keys preload, contextIsolation, nodeIntegration, sandbox, webSecurity and allowRunningInsecureContent, one entry per window or view and key that the code writes, directly or through makeWindow; keys the code does not write are not listed with Electron's defaults. Each entry has a field window naming the variable. Channels made by defineChannels(area, actions) are `${area}:${action}`: the function is pure and every argument is a literal, so the names follow from the source text by evaluating it (a reader can do this; a tool must model the loop and the template); these channels count as resolvable. The two zoom members use `zoom:${token}`, where the token is crypto.randomUUID() in main.js handed to the preload on the command line (additionalArguments); no static reading names that channel. Storage kinds: sessionStorage, localStorage, indexedDB, cookie (session.defaultSession.cookies in main.js) and file (the app's own JSON settings file, written with fs in main.js); cookie and file are kinds this set adds, see the README. interfaceLinks follows holdout3: a handler registered through a helper (the handle(channel)(fn) decorator, the constructor of LaneListeners) or a send made through a helper (forward(), an EventEmitter bridge) has the line of the ipcMain / webContents call inside the helper as its line, and the line where the channel is given to the helper as entryLine. An expectation states what the program does, also where that is hard to see; what only looks like a finding is listed under absent.

present.why: main.js: handle(board.list)(async () => ...), handle being `(channel) => (fn) => { ipcMain.handle(channel, ...) }` and board = defineChannels("board", ["list", "move", "archive", "changed"]) from lib/channels.js. preload.js listBoards: ipcRenderer.invoke(board.list)
handle(board.move)(...); preload.js moveCard
handle(board.archive)(...); preload.js archiveBoard

main.js: forward("board-changed", board.changed, () => boardWindow) subscribes to the EventEmitter bus and calls contents.send(channel, payload) on the board window's webContents whenever the bus emits board-changed (in changed(), called by most handlers and by LaneListeners). preload.js onBoardChanged: subscribe(board.changed, listener), subscribe being a preload helper that calls ipcRenderer.on

main.js handle(card.create)(...). preload.js: the member create of "cards" is cardRemote.create, read from a Proxy whose get trap returns (...args) => ipcRenderer.invoke(card[member], ...args); card.create is "card:create"
handle(card.rename)(...); cardRemote.rename through the Proxy
handle(card.remove)(...); cardRemote.remove through the Proxy (no page calls it, the member exists)

defineChannels turns the action "link-preview" into the key linkPreview and the name card:link-preview. main.js handle(card.linkPreview)(...); preload.js cardRemote.linkPreview, whose get trap reads card["linkPreview"]
